plan.title: Asset PR to RFQ Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Ensure the award is full quantity rather than partial.
Enable eRFX project creation for the PR flow.
Allow Vendor A and Vendor B to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Add both named vendors to the RFQ.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Publish the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Submit Vendor A's RFQ quote.
Confirm Vendor A's quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's RFQ quote.
Confirm Vendor B's quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ while retaining its quotes and participants.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Confirm Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Confirm Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid for both auction bidders.
Verify the lower bid ranks first.
Verify Vendor A's auction rate is 85.
Enter the awarding flow.
Allocate all 10 units to Vendor A.
Verify the full allocation and 10 × 85 proposal value.
Create and submit the award proposal for Vendor A.
Confirm the award proposal was submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver and approve the submitted award with a remark

steps.note: The case names a separate approver, whose authentication and approval cannot be guaranteed by the buyer session.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Confirm the PO contains the awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event's lifecycle location.
Open the History tab after completion.
Confirm this plan's completed event moved into History.
